newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell denies rights issue rumours.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell denies rights issue rumours.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had no immediate plans for a rights issue.
The company issued a statement through the stock exchange after the close as rumours swirled that it was about to make a cash call.
"The company wish to state that the company has no immediate plan for rights issues," said managing director Gordon Wu in the statement.
Brokers said Hopewell shares were depressed on Friday by rumours that the company planned a 2-for-5 rights issue at HK$3.60 per share to raise HK$6.3 billion.
Hopewell fell to an intraday low of HK$4.075 before ended at HK$4.125 on Friday, down HK$0.225 or 5.17 percent.
Volume was 42.89 million shares worth HK$178.17 million.
